人教版 必修第二册 第五章第二节「氮及其化合物」二、一氧化氮和二氧化氮（印刷 p: PEP Required Book 2, Ch. 5, Sec. 2 "Nitrogen and Its Compounds", Part 2: Nitric Oxide and Nitrogen Dioxide (printed p.13), Part 4: Nitric Acid (printed p.15)
浓、稀硝酸的性质与氮氧化物的转化: Properties of Concentrated and Dilute Nitric Acid and Interconversion of Nitrogen Oxides
同样是铜和硝酸，为什么一瓶冒红棕色气体、另一瓶什么颜色都没有？: It's copper and nitric acid both times. Why does one tube give off red-brown gas and the other a colorless one?
浓硝酸把 N 留在 +4（NO₂ 红棕），稀硝酸降到 +2（NO 无色）: Concentrated nitric acid leaves N at +4 (NO₂, red-brown); dilute takes it down to +2 (NO, colorless)
2NO + O₂ = 2NO₂：无色的气体一碰空气就变红棕: 2NO + O₂ = 2NO₂: the colorless gas turns red-brown as soon as it touches air
3NO₂ + H₂O = 2HNO₃ + NO：红棕褪去，气体少了 2/3: 3NO₂ + H₂O = 2HNO₃ + NO: the red-brown fades and the gas shrinks by 2/3
尾气用 NaOH 吸收；浓硝酸装棕色瓶、放阴凉处: Absorb tail gas in NaOH; store concentrated nitric acid in a brown bottle in a cool place
两支试管 + 一个注射器 + 一条气路: Two test tubes + one syringe + one gas line
整体 · 先让金属与硝酸接触，再把气体收进注射器转化掉: Overview · first bring metal and nitric acid together, then draw the gas into a syringe and convert it
拨一个开关，气体颜色、气泡和读数一起变: Flip a switch and the gas color, bubbles and readings change together
全对！记住这条主线：浓硝酸 → NO₂（红棕），稀硝酸 → NO（无色），NO: All correct! Remember the main thread: concentrated nitric acid → NO₂ (red-brown), dilute nitric acid → NO (colorless), NO turns red-brown in air, and NO₂ disproportionates in water into nitric acid + NO.
建议回看主线：先看浓稀硝酸的产物不同，再看 NO 遇空气变红棕，最后看 NO₂: Try reviewing the main thread: first see that concentrated and dilute nitric acid give different products, then that NO turns red-brown in air, and finally why NO₂ in water both loses its color and shrinks in volume.
示意放大 · 正在看：③ 注射器里的气体: Magnified view · now viewing: ③ gas in the syringe
发生站：金属丝插入 / 抽出、气泡、管内气体颜色、溶液颜色: Generator: metal wire in / out, bubbles, gas color in the tube, solution color
尾气：导管气路、烧杯里冒泡、未接通时逸出的红棕色烟带: Tail gas: tubing, bubbling in the beaker, red-brown plume escaping when not connected
试剂瓶：棕色瓶 / 透明瓶，见光分解时瓶内出现红棕色: Reagent bottle: brown / clear; red-brown appears inside when it decomposes in light
注射器：液面、活塞位置、管内气体颜色、刻度: Syringe: liquid level, plunger position, gas color inside, scale
示意放大（N 的价态 +5 / +4 / +2 与 NO₂ 歧化）: Magnified view (N oxidation states +5 / +4 / +2 and NO₂ disproportionation)
注射器内气体体积 — 吸入空气量: Gas volume in syringe vs air drawn in
两支具支试管并排：左管「铜 + 2 mL 浓硝酸」作对照，右管随工况变；各从橡胶: Two side-arm test tubes side by side: the left tube "copper + 2 mL concentrated nitric acid" is the control, the right tube changes with the setting; each has a metal wire (copper coil / iron strip) set into a groove in the side of the rubber stopper, and the side arms join into one tube through rubber connectors (textbook Fig. 5-14)
烧杯盛 NaOH 溶液，导管末端浸在液面以下冒泡；未接通时管口向上冒出红棕色烟带: A beaker holds NaOH solution with the end of the tube below the surface, bubbling; when not connected, a red-brown plume rises from the tube mouth (NOx escaping)
50 mL 注射器（筒身 10–50 mL 刻度）+ 吸入的 5 mL 水 +: 50 mL syringe (10–50 mL scale on the barrel) + 5 mL of water drawn in + latex tube + pinch clamp, with 20 mL of NO inside (textbook Fig. 5-10)
台面后上方的圆视窗：NO（蓝灰双原子）、NO₂（红棕弯折三原子）、HNO₃（无色: Round window above the back of the bench: NO (blue-grey, two atoms), NO₂ (red-brown, bent, three atoms) and HNO₃ (colorless) appear in their current amounts, each N tagged with a +5 / +4 / +2 badge
桌上这一串东西，哪一段在「造」气体，哪一段在「吃」气体？: Of this row of equipment on the bench, which part "makes" gas and which part "consumes" it?
四个站位都在：① 两支具支试管并排（左管铜丝插在浓硝酸里、管口冒红棕；右管同款，: All four stations are here: ① two side-arm test tubes side by side (the left with a copper wire in concentrated nitric acid, red-brown at the mouth; the right identical but with its wire not yet lowered), each side arm joining one tube; ② NaOH solution in a beaker with the tube end below the surface, bubbling; ③ a 50 mL syringe on the bench with a 10–50 mL scale and some water inside; ④ the magnified window above the back. Main reading 0.0 % (wire not lowered yet)
常温 · 铜丝从塞侧凹槽插入 · 尾气 NaOH 吸收: Room temperature · copper wire through the stopper groove · tail gas absorbed by NaOH
从左到右就是操作顺序：先让金属与硝酸接触产生气体 → 尾气吸收 → 把无色气体收: Left to right is the order of operations: bring metal and nitric acid together to make gas → absorb the tail gas → draw the colorless gas into the syringe for the conversion experiment.
两支试管是同高的对照：左管始终是「铜 + 浓硝酸」，右管才是被改的那一支；注射器: The two test tubes are a matched control: the left is always "copper + concentrated nitric acid", and only the right one is changed; the 20 mL of gas in the syringe was collected from this setup.
教材图5-14 的两支试管本来就是「浓一支、稀一支，观察并比较」；本课把左管固定: The two tubes in textbook Fig. 5-14 were meant as "one concentrated, one dilute, observe and compare"; this lesson fixes the left tube as the baseline and lets the right one vary, so every step has a control.
去掉这一步：学生不知道自己在看哪一段，后面每换一个开关都对不上位置。: Skip this step and students don't know which part they're looking at, and later switches don't match up with positions.
常考：硝酸与金属反应装置的「发生 → 尾气」两段结构；教材图5-14 为什么用两: Commonly tested: the two-part "generate → tail gas" structure of the nitric acid and metal setup; why textbook Fig. 5-14 uses two side-arm test tubes.
这就是教材「氮及其化合物」里的两个实验摆在一张台面上：一套是图5-14 的「硝酸: These are two experiments from the textbook's "Nitrogen and Its Compounds" on one bench: Fig. 5-14, "nitric acid reacting with copper" (two side-arm test tubes + NaOH for tail gas), and Fig. 5-10, "nitrogen dioxide dissolving in water" (syringe).
铜丝一插进浓硝酸，为什么马上冒出红棕色气体？: Why does red-brown gas appear the moment the copper wire goes into concentrated nitric acid?
把金属丝插下去（浸入液面），看气体颜色和三个读数: Lower the metal wire (into the liquid) and watch the gas color and the three readings
铜丝一插下去，实验管里立刻剧烈冒泡、管内气体变成红棕色，气体中 NO₂ 的体积分: As soon as the copper wire goes in, the test tube bubbles vigorously and the gas inside turns red-brown; the NO₂ volume fraction jumps from 0.0 % to 100.0 %, and the solution turns from colorless to green; the control tube on the left gives red-brown gas too. Pull the wire up and the bubbling stops at once, with no more red-brown
常温 · 铜丝插入浓硝酸 · 尾气 NaOH 吸收: Room temperature · copper wire in concentrated nitric acid · tail gas absorbed by NaOH
硝酸与金属反应不放氢气（放 H₂ 的是稀硫酸、盐酸那一路）；浓硝酸的还原产物是: Nitric acid reacting with metals doesn't release hydrogen (that's dilute sulfuric and hydrochloric acid); the reduction product of concentrated nitric acid is NO₂, with N going from +5 to +4.
红棕色是 NO₂ 的颜色，NO 是无色的；两种气体都无色无味地记混，是这课最常见: Red-brown is the color of NO₂; NO is colorless. Mixing up which gas is colorless is the most common mistake in this lesson.
教材练习第 6 题原文说浓硝酸这一支「反应剧烈进行，铜丝逐渐变细，溶液变绿，试管: Textbook exercise 6 says that for concentrated nitric acid "the reaction is vigorous, the copper wire gradually thins, the solution turns green, and red-brown gas appears above"; the green isn't copper ions changing color: NO₂ dissolved in the acid looks yellow and Cu²⁺ looks blue, and together they look green.
去掉这一步：学生把「红棕色气体」背成口诀，却不知道那就是 NO₂，也说不清「向上: Skip this step and students memorize "red-brown gas" as a phrase without knowing it's NO₂, and can't say why "pulling up the copper wire" stops the reaction.
高频：铜与浓硝酸的现象与方程式；硝酸与金属反应为什么不放氢气；「向上拉铜丝」的作: Frequently tested: observations and equation for copper with concentrated nitric acid; why nitric acid with metals doesn't release hydrogen; what "pulling up the copper wire" does.
硝酸是很强的氧化剂：它把铜氧化成 Cu²⁺，自身被还原成 NO₂（N 由 +5: Nitric acid is a strong oxidizer: it oxidizes copper to Cu²⁺ and is itself reduced to NO₂ (N from +5 to +4, each N gaining 1 electron); NO₂ is a red-brown gas. The textbook uses "pull up the copper wire" to stop the reaction at any time.
换成稀硝酸，气体怎么变成无色了？它跑到哪去了？: With dilute nitric acid, why does the gas become colorless? Where did the color go?
把实验工况从「浓硝酸」拨到「稀硝酸」，盯住颜色与三个读数: Switch the setting from "Concentrated" to "Dilute" nitric acid, watching the color and three readings
换成稀硝酸：气泡从「剧烈」变成「缓慢」，溶液从绿色变蓝色，管内气体无色、气体中: With dilute nitric acid: bubbling goes from "vigorous" to "slow", the solution turns from green to blue, the gas in the tube is colorless, and the NO₂ volume fraction drops from 100.0 % to 0.0 %; the control tube on the left is still red-brown. A faint layer of red-brown appears near the tube mouth: the colorless gas turns red as soon as it meets air
常温 · 铜丝插入 · 尾气 NaOH 吸收: Room temperature · copper wire lowered · tail gas absorbed by NaOH
浓、稀硝酸的还原产物不同（NO₂ / NO），但都不是氢气：N 分别被还原到 +: Concentrated and dilute nitric acid give different reduction products (NO₂ / NO), but neither gives hydrogen: N is reduced to +4 and +2 respectively.
稀硝酸实验中「试管中的气体略有红棕色」是 NO 被空气里的氧气氧化了，不是稀硝酸: "The gas in the tube is slightly red-brown" in the dilute nitric acid experiment is NO being oxidized by oxygen in the air, not dilute nitric acid producing red-brown gas (textbook exercise 6).
同样多的铜，稀硝酸放出的气体物质的量只有浓硝酸的 1/3：1 mol Cu 失: For the same amount of copper, dilute nitric acid releases only 1/3 as many moles of gas as concentrated: 1 mol Cu gives up 2 mol electrons, which makes 2 mol NO₂ with concentrated acid but 2/3 mol NO with dilute.
去掉这一步：学生会以为「硝酸和铜反应就是出红棕色气体」，考到稀硝酸就答错。: Skip this step and students think "nitric acid and copper always give red-brown gas", and get dilute nitric acid questions wrong.
高频：稀硝酸与铜反应的现象、化学方程式与离子方程式；「略有红棕色」的原因。: Frequently tested: observations, chemical equation and ionic equation for copper with dilute nitric acid; why it's "slightly red-brown".
稀硝酸的氧化性比浓硝酸弱：N 只被还原到 +2，产物是无色、难溶于水的 NO（每: Dilute nitric acid is a weaker oxidizer than concentrated: N is only reduced to +2, giving colorless NO that is barely soluble in water (each N gains 3 electrons). As soon as NO touches oxygen in the air it becomes red-brown NO₂ (2NO + O₂ = 2NO₂), so "colorless" is only temporary.
同一片铁片放进浓硝酸，怎么连气泡都没有了？: Put an iron strip into concentrated nitric acid. Why are there no bubbles at all?
把金属从「铜丝」换成「铁片」（常温、浓硝酸），看气泡和读数: Switch the metal from "Copper wire" to "Iron strip" (room temperature, concentrated nitric acid) and watch the bubbles and readings
铜丝换成铁片后，气泡几乎立刻停住、气体中 NO₂ 的体积分数掉回 0.0 %、溶: With the iron strip, bubbling stops almost at once, the NO₂ volume fraction drops back to 0.0 %, and the solution doesn't change, while the control tube on the left (copper + concentrated nitric acid) still bubbles red-brown vigorously. Switch the setting back to "Dilute" and the same iron strip bubbles steadily again
物料：Fe（或 Cu）+ HNO₃（常温、浓硝酸）: Materials: Fe (or Cu) + HNO₃ (room temperature, concentrated)
常温 · 浓硝酸 · 不加热: Room temperature · concentrated nitric acid · no heating
钝化不是「铁不与硝酸反应」，而是表面被浓硝酸氧化出一层致密薄膜，把内部金属盖住、: Passivation isn't "iron doesn't react with nitric acid"; the surface is oxidized by concentrated nitric acid into a dense film that covers the metal inside and stops further reaction.
判据是气泡：钝化和铁遇稀硝酸这两格的 φ 都是 0.0 %，光看 φ 分不出来，: Bubbles are the test: passivation and iron in dilute nitric acid both show φ = 0.0 %, so φ alone can't tell them apart; you must look at "reaction rate".
两个条件缺一不可：常温 + 浓硝酸。同一片铁片放进稀硝酸里照样持续冒泡（教材原话: Both conditions are needed: room temperature + concentrated nitric acid. The same iron strip bubbles steadily in dilute nitric acid (textbook: iron and aluminum "although they can react with dilute nitric or dilute sulfuric acid").
去掉这一步：学生把「钝化」背成名词，说不清它是「表面氧化成致密膜」还是「根本不反: Skip this step and students memorize "passivation" as a word, unable to say whether it's "the surface oxidizing into a dense film" or "no reaction at all".
高频：常温下为什么可以用铁、铝制容器盛装浓硝酸；钝化与「不反应」的区别。: Frequently tested: why iron or aluminum containers can hold concentrated nitric acid at room temperature; the difference between passivation and "no reaction".
常温下铁、铝的表面被浓硝酸氧化，生成一层致密薄膜把内部金属盖住（钝化），反应很快: At room temperature the surfaces of iron and aluminum are oxidized by concentrated nitric acid into a dense film that covers the metal inside (passivation), and the reaction soon stops, so iron and aluminum containers can hold concentrated nitric acid; but the same iron reacts in dilute nitric acid.
把尾气导管插回 NaOH 溶液（起始是没接），看烟带和风险条: Put the tail gas tube back into the NaOH solution (it starts disconnected) and watch the plume and the risk bar
尾气未接时：导管口向上飘出一股红棕色烟带，风险条升到 0.85（报警），旁边写着: With tail gas not connected: a red-brown plume drifts up from the tube mouth, the risk bar rises to 0.85 (alarm), labeled "NOx escaping · toxic"; put the tube back into the NaOH solution and the plume disappears, small bubbles keep rising in the beaker, and the risk drops back to 0.10, while the main reading doesn't change at all (still 100.0 %)
尾气：NO、NO₂ + NaOH 溶液: Tail gas: NO, NO₂ + NaOH solution
导管末端浸入液面以下: Tube end below the liquid surface
尾气开关是安全开关：接不接它，主读数一格都不变（对照第 2 步的 100.0 %: The tail gas switch is a safety switch: connected or not, the main reading doesn't change at all (compare the 100.0 % in step 2).
导管要浸到液面以下才算「吸收」，悬在液面上方等于直排。: The tube must be below the surface to count as "absorbing"; hanging above the surface is the same as venting straight out.
教材没有给 NOx 与 NaOH 反应的方程式，本课也不写，只照图5-14 的图: The textbook doesn't give the equation for NOx with NaOH, and this lesson doesn't either; it only follows the caption of Fig. 5-14, "absorb with NaOH solution".
去掉这一步：学生做完实验就把红棕色气体排进实验室，还以为「开窗通风就行」。: Skip this step and students vent red-brown gas into the lab after the experiment, thinking "opening a window is enough".
高频：有毒尾气的处理（碱液吸收）；硝酸的腐蚀性与挥发性（教材「注意」栏）。: Frequently tested: handling toxic tail gas (absorption in alkali); the corrosiveness and volatility of nitric acid (the textbook's "Caution" box).
NO 和 NO₂ 都是有毒气体。教材图5-14 右边那只烧杯里装的就是 NaOH: NO and NO₂ are both toxic gases. The beaker on the right of textbook Fig. 5-14 holds NaOH solution with the tube end below the surface to absorb the tail gas; connecting it only affects safety and the environment, not how much gas you make.
浓硝酸为什么非得装在棕色瓶里、还得放阴凉处？: Why must concentrated nitric acid be kept in a brown bottle, and in a cool place?
把浓硝酸从「透明瓶见光」换回「棕色瓶避光」，看瓶子和风险条: Switch the concentrated nitric acid from "Clear bottle in light" back to "Brown bottle, dark" and watch the bottle and the risk bar
透明瓶见光时，瓶口和瓶内出现红棕色气体，风险条升到 0.60（「浓硝酸分解 ·: In a clear bottle in light, red-brown gas appears at the mouth and inside, and the risk bar rises to 0.60 ("Concentrated nitric acid decomposing · reagent spoiling"); back in a brown bottle in a cool place, the red-brown disappears and the risk drops back to 0.10. The main reading stays 100.0 % (it's the acid in the bottle that decomposes, not the gas in the test tube)
分解产物里有 NO₂，所以「看见红棕色」本身就说明酸已经在分解。: The decomposition products include NO₂, so "seeing red-brown" itself shows the acid is decomposing.
不只避光：受热一样分解，所以还要放阴凉处。: Not just light: heat decomposes it too, so it also needs a cool place.
这是保存问题不是反应问题：换掉瓶子，试管里的反应一点都不变。: This is a storage issue, not a reaction issue: change the bottle and the reaction in the test tube doesn't change at all.
去掉这一步：学生知道「棕色瓶」却写不出原因方程式，练习第 6(1) 题就丢分。: Skip this step and students know "brown bottle" but can't write the equation for why, losing marks on exercise 6(1).
高频：硝酸盛放在棕色试剂瓶的原因（要求写方程式）；见光或受热分解的产物。: Frequently tested: why nitric acid is stored in brown reagent bottles (equation required); the products of decomposition by light or heat.
浓硝酸见光或受热会分解：4HNO₃ = 4NO₂↑ + O₂↑ + 2H₂O，放: Concentrated nitric acid decomposes in light or when heated: 4HNO₃ = 4NO₂↑ + O₂↑ + 2H₂O. The NO₂ released turns the acid yellow and raises the pressure in the bottle, so it must be kept in a brown reagent bottle in a cool place. This is also the answer to textbook exercise 6(1).
无色的 NO 吸进 10 mL 空气，怎么立刻变红了？: Draw 10 mL of air into the colorless NO. Why does it turn red at once?
把吸入空气从 0 拖到 10、20、30 mL，看颜色、气体体积和曲线: Drag the air drawn in from 0 to 10, 20 and 30 mL, watching the color, gas volume and curve
吸 0 → 10 → 20 → 30 mL 空气：气体中 NO₂ 的体积分数 0: Drawing in 0 → 10 → 20 → 30 mL of air: the NO₂ volume fraction goes 0.0 → 15.1 → 23.5 → 28.8 %, the gas volume in the syringe 20.0 → 27.9 → 35.8 → 43.7 mL, the red-brown deepens layer by layer, and the plunger is pushed out
常温 · 50 mL 注射器 · 空气按 21 % O₂: Room temperature · 50 mL syringe · air taken as 21 % O₂
决定颜色的是「吸进来的氧气有多少」，不是「吸了几口」：每 10 mL 空气只带: What sets the color is "how much oxygen is drawn in", not "how many draws": each 10 mL of air brings only 2.1 mL of O₂.
一次吸 10 mL 空气远不够把 20 mL NO 全部转化——教材思考题问的就: One 10 mL draw of air is far from enough to convert all 20 mL of NO; this is exactly what the textbook's thinking question asks.
注射器只有 50 mL，最多吸到第 3 轮，所以要让 NO 充分转化必须反复吸、: The syringe is only 50 mL, so you can draw at most 3 rounds; to convert NO fully you must draw and shake repeatedly.
去掉这一步：学生以为「NO 一遇空气就全变 NO₂」，算不出还剩多少 NO。: Skip this step and students think "NO turns entirely into NO₂ as soon as it meets air" and can't calculate how much NO is left.
常考：NO 与 O₂ 反应的体积计算；「无色气体遇空气变红棕」的定量解释。: Commonly tested: volume calculations for NO with O₂; the quantitative explanation of "colorless gas turns red-brown in air".
空气里只有约 21 % 的氧气：吸 10 mL 空气只带进 2.1 mL O₂，: Air is only about 21 % oxygen: drawing in 10 mL of air brings just 2.1 mL of O₂, enough to oxidize only 4.2 mL of NO to NO₂ (2NO + O₂ = 2NO₂). So how deep the color gets depends on how much air you draw in, and the remaining NO stays colorless.
A2.1、A3.1、A5.5、B2.1 算子 2、D3、D12: A2.1, A3.1, A5.5, B2.1 operator 2, D3, D12
摇一摇注射器，红棕色为什么褪了、活塞为什么往里缩？: Shake the syringe. Why does the red-brown fade and the plunger move in?
停 5 秒，看红棕色褪去、活塞往里缩，同时看视窗里 NO₂ 分裂成 HNO₃ 和: Wait 5 seconds and watch the red-brown fade and the plunger move in, while NO₂ splits into HNO₃ and NO in the window
振荡后红棕色褪去，气体中 NO₂ 的体积分数从 23.5 % 回到 0.0 %，: After shaking, the red-brown fades, the NO₂ volume fraction goes from 23.5 % back to 0.0 %, and the gas volume in the syringe falls from 35.8 mL to 30.2 mL (the plunger moves in 5.6 mL, 2.8 mL per round); in the window NO₂ molecules split into colorless HNO₃ and blue-grey NO, and two oxidation-state arrows light up together: +4 → +5 (losing electrons) and +4 → +2 (gaining electrons)
NO₂ 溶于水不是「被水吸住不动」，而是歧化：一部分变成硝酸、一部分又变回 NO: NO₂ dissolving in water isn't "held by the water"; it disproportionates: some becomes nitric acid and some turns back into NO.
所以吸收不彻底：每 3 mol NO₂ 只得到 2 mol 硝酸，另 1 mol: So absorption is incomplete: every 3 mol of NO₂ gives only 2 mol of nitric acid, while 1 mol turns back into NO; industry has to add more air to reoxidize it (curriculum context "industrial nitric acid production").
每轮活塞内缩 2.8 mL 正好等于那一轮被吸收 NO₂ 体积的 2/3（4.2: Each round the plunger moves in 2.8 mL, exactly 2/3 of the NO₂ volume absorbed that round (4.2 × 2/3).
去掉这一步：学生只会背「NO₂ 溶于水生成硝酸」，答不出「红棕色褪去后气体为什么: Skip this step and students only memorize "NO₂ dissolves in water to form nitric acid", unable to say why the gas shrinks after the red-brown fades, or why NO₂ is both oxidizer and reducer.
高频：NO₂ 与水的反应（歧化）；「NO₂ 既是氧化剂又是还原剂」；气体体积差计: Frequently tested: the reaction of NO₂ with water (disproportionation); "NO₂ is both oxidizer and reducer"; gas volume-difference calculations.
NO₂ 溶于水时发生歧化：3NO₂ + H₂O = 2HNO₃ + NO，3 个: NO₂ disproportionates when it dissolves in water: 3NO₂ + H₂O = 2HNO₃ + NO; of 3 N atoms, 2 rise to +5 and 1 falls to +2, so NO₂ is both oxidizer and reducer; every 3 volumes of NO₂ leave just 1 volume of NO, so the gas shrinks by 2/3 and the plunger moves in.
考核：把注射器里的 NO 尽量转化成硝酸，同时守住两条安全线: Assessment: convert as much of the NO in the syringe to nitric acid as possible, while holding both safety lines
至少吸两轮空气（≥ 20 mL）且每轮都振荡，让红棕色完全褪去（0.0 %）；尾: Draw at least two rounds of air (≥ 20 mL), shaking each round, until the red-brown is completely gone (0.0 %); keep the tail gas connected to NaOH and the concentrated nitric acid in the dark, and hold for 15 seconds. Partway through the tail gas will be disconnected
达标横幅「NO 的转化 · 达标」；进入 5 s 后尾气被拔掉（风险跳到 0.8: Pass banner "NO conversion · passed"; at 5 s the tail gas is disconnected (risk jumps to 0.85) and you must reconnect it. The reference setup draws 20 mL of air and shakes: the red-brown is gone, gas 30.2 mL, only 14.4 mL of NO left
φ = 0.0 % · 空气 ≥ 20 mL · 尾气已接 · 已避光 · 保持: φ = 0.0 % · air ≥ 20 mL · tail gas connected · kept dark · hold 15 s
只吸空气不振荡：红棕色越积越深、φ 一路涨到 28.8 %，永远达不到 0.0: Drawing in air without shaking: the red-brown keeps building and φ climbs to 28.8 %, never reaching 0.0 %.
少吸一轮就差一截：每轮振荡后 NO 只减少 2.8 mL（20 → 17.2 →: One round short leaves a gap: each shake only reduces NO by 2.8 mL (20 → 17.2 → 14.4 mL).
尾气被拔掉是唯一会「把分扣回来」的异常，别只盯着读数。: The tail gas being disconnected is the only fault that "takes points back", so don't watch only the reading.
满分结构：反复吸空气 + 每次振荡 + 尾气吸收 + 棕色瓶避光。: Full-marks structure: draw air repeatedly + shake each time + absorb tail gas + brown bottle in the dark.
考核没有新结论：NO 要反复通空气并振荡才能转化得多；尾气不接收、硝酸不避光，实: The assessment has no new conclusion: NO only converts well with repeated air and shaking; if the tail gas isn't absorbed or the acid isn't kept dark, the experiment fails however nice it looks.

本班目标：至少吸两轮空气（≥ 20 mL）且每轮都振荡，使红棕色褪去（φ = 0: Class goal: draw at least two rounds of air (≥ 20 mL), shaking each round, so the red-brown fades (φ = 0.0 %); tail gas into NaOH, concentrated nitric acid in a brown bottle in the dark, held for 15 seconds
铜分别与浓硝酸、稀硝酸反应，被还原的产物是: When copper reacts with concentrated and with dilute nitric acid, the reduction products are
教材印刷 p.15：4HNO₃(浓) + Cu = Cu(NO₃)₂ + 2NO: Textbook printed p.15: 4HNO₃(conc.) + Cu = Cu(NO₃)₂ + 2NO₂↑ + 2H₂O, 8HNO₃(dilute) + 3Cu = 3Cu(NO₃)₂ + 2NO↑ + 4H₂O. Different concentrations of nitric acid give different products with metals; neither releases hydrogen.
做铜与稀硝酸的实验时，试管里的气体「略有红棕色」，原因是: In the copper and dilute nitric acid experiment, the gas in the tube is "slightly red-brown" because
稀硝酸被还原成 NO₂: Dilute nitric acid was reduced to NO₂
生成的无色 NO 被空气里的氧气氧化了: The colorless NO formed was oxidized by oxygen in the air
溶液里的水蒸气显红棕色: Water vapor in the solution is red-brown
教材练习与应用第 6(2)② 题（印刷 p.18）就是这一问的答案：2NO +: Textbook practice question 6(2)② (printed p.18) is answered by this: 2NO + O₂ = 2NO₂. Dilute nitric acid's only reduction product is NO (colorless); it turns red when it meets oxygen in the air.
在 NO₂ 与水的反应中，下列说法正确的是: In the reaction of NO₂ with water, which statement is correct?
氮元素的化合价不发生变化: The oxidation state of nitrogen doesn't change
NO₂ 只是氧化剂: NO₂ is only the oxidizing agent
NO₂ 只是还原剂: NO₂ is only the reducing agent
NO₂ 既是氧化剂，又是还原剂: NO₂ is both the oxidizing agent and the reducing agent
教材练习与应用第 2 题（印刷 p.18）答案 D。3NO₂ + H₂O = 2: Textbook practice question 2 (printed p.18), answer D. 3NO₂ + H₂O = 2HNO₃ + NO: of 3 N atoms, 2 rise from +4 to +5 as nitric acid and 1 falls from +4 to +2 as NO, so NO₂ is both oxidizer and reducer.
硝酸一般盛放在棕色试剂瓶中，原因是（用方程式说明）: Nitric acid is usually stored in brown reagent bottles because (explain with an equation)
4HNO₃ = 4NO₂↑ + O₂↑ + 2H₂O（见光或受热分解）: 4HNO₃ = 4NO₂↑ + O₂↑ + 2H₂O (decomposes in light or when heated)
硝酸挥发得快，怕见光变浓: Nitric acid evaporates quickly and gets more concentrated in light
教材印刷 p.15 原话「浓硝酸见光或者受热会分解产生二氧化氮，所以一般将其保存: Textbook printed p.15: "Concentrated nitric acid decomposes in light or when heated to produce nitrogen dioxide, so it is generally stored in brown reagent bottles in a cool place"; equation 4HNO₃ = 4NO₂↑ + O₂↑ + 2H₂O (conditions: light or △). This is also practice question 6(1).
常温下可以用铁制、铝制容器盛装浓硝酸，原因是: At room temperature, iron or aluminum containers can hold concentrated nitric acid because
铁、铝不与硝酸反应: Iron and aluminum don't react with nitric acid
铁、铝的表面被浓硝酸氧化出一层致密薄膜，阻止内部金属继续反应: Concentrated nitric acid oxidizes the surface of iron and aluminum into a dense film that stops the metal inside from reacting further
浓硝酸挥发太快，来不及反应: Concentrated nitric acid evaporates too fast to react
铁、铝在浓硝酸里被钝化，所以连稀硝酸也不反应: Iron and aluminum are passivated by concentrated nitric acid, so they don't react with dilute nitric acid either
教材印刷 p.15：铁、铝「虽然能与稀硝酸或稀硫酸反应」，但常温下表面被浓硝酸氧: Textbook printed p.15: iron and aluminum, "although they can react with dilute nitric or dilute sulfuric acid", have their surfaces oxidized by concentrated nitric acid at room temperature into a dense film (passivation), so they can hold concentrated nitric acid. Note the conditions, room temperature and concentrated acid: in dilute nitric acid they still react (the bubble reading in step 4 of this lesson is the test).
铜与浓硝酸反应后剩下的尾气，最合理的处理方法是: The most sensible way to handle the tail gas left after copper reacts with concentrated nitric acid is
直接排到室内，开窗通风: Vent it into the room and open a window
通入 NaOH 溶液吸收: Pass it into NaOH solution to absorb it
用排水法收集起来留着: Collect it over water and keep it
点燃让它烧掉: Light it and burn it off
NO、NO₂ 都是有毒气体（教材印刷 p.13），教材图5-14 画的装置就是让: NO and NO₂ are both toxic gases (textbook printed p.13), and the setup in textbook Fig. 5-14 passes the gas through a tube into NaOH solution in a beaker (tube end below the surface). NO turns into NO₂ in air, and NO₂ dissolves readily in water and reacts with alkali, so it's absorbed by alkaline solution; venting or burning won't do.
换成铜丝：与浓硝酸剧烈反应，放出红棕色 NO₂: Switched to copper wire: reacts vigorously with concentrated nitric acid, giving red-brown NO₂
换成铁片：常温下浓硝酸把表面氧化出致密薄膜（钝化），反应很快停住: Switched to iron strip: at room temperature concentrated nitric acid oxidizes the surface into a dense film (passivation), and the reaction soon stops
金属丝插入硝酸：反应开始，气体向上经支管进入导管: Metal wire lowered into the acid: the reaction starts, and gas rises through the side arm into the tube
向上拉出金属丝：脱离液面，反应立即终止: Metal wire pulled up: out of the liquid, the reaction stops at once
尾气接回 NaOH 溶液：导管末端浸入液面以下，NOx 被吸收: Tail gas reconnected to NaOH solution: the tube end is below the surface and NOx is absorbed
尾气未接：NOx 直接逸出，有毒，风险条报警: Tail gas not connected: NOx escapes directly; it's toxic, and the risk bar alarms
换回棕色试剂瓶、放阴凉处：见光与受热分解都被挡住: Back in a brown reagent bottle in a cool place: decomposition by light and heat is blocked
换成透明瓶见光：浓硝酸分解出 NO₂，试剂变质: Switched to a clear bottle in light: concentrated nitric acid decomposes to NO₂, and the reagent spoils
振荡注射器：NO₂ 溶进水里歧化成硝酸和 NO，红棕褪去、气体变少: Syringe shaken: NO₂ dissolves in the water and disproportionates into nitric acid and NO; the red-brown fades and the gas shrinks
停止振荡：NO₂ 留在气体里，红棕色不退: Shaking stopped: NO₂ stays in the gas and the red-brown doesn't fade
异常：尾气被拔掉了——风险 0.85 报警，先把它插回 NaOH 溶液: Fault: the tail gas was disconnected. Risk 0.85 alarm, so put it back into the NaOH solution first
已回到参考工况：教材图5-14 原状（铜丝抽出、尾气接好、棕色瓶避光）: Back to the reference setup: as in textbook Fig. 5-14 (copper wire raised, tail gas connected, brown bottle in the dark)
本课目标：看清浓、稀硝酸与金属反应的产物差别（NO₂ 红棕 / NO 无色），再: Lesson goal: see clearly how the products of concentrated and dilute nitric acid with metals differ (NO₂ red-brown / NO colorless), then watch NO turn red-brown in air and NO₂ disproportionate in water, and finally hold the two safety lines of tail gas absorption and dark brown-bottle storage.
示意声明：装置组成与操作取自人教版必修第二册 图5-14（硝酸与铜反应，印刷 p: Disclaimer: the apparatus and procedures come from PEP Required Book 2 Fig. 5-14 (nitric acid with copper, printed p.15), Fig. 5-10 and Exp. 5-5 (nitrogen dioxide dissolving in water, printed p.13); equations and observations such as "solution turns green / blue", "vigorous reaction" and "bubbles form" come from the textbook text and practice question 6 (printed p.18). The NO₂ volume fraction, gas volume in the syringe, bubble rate, solution color depth and risk values are teaching illustrations (lesson settings); the textbook gives no such numbers. Air is taken as 21 % O₂, 79 % N₂ (standard values). "The surface of iron and aluminum is oxidized by concentrated nitric acid into a dense film" is textbook wording; the following "stops the metal inside from reacting further" is cut off at the bottom of printed p.15 and is inferred from the same paragraph's "iron or aluminum containers can hold concentrated nitric acid", so it isn't presented as textbook wording. The textbook doesn't give equations for NOx with NaOH or iron with nitric acid, and this lesson doesn't either.
